label: Curated vault
text: Identify the underlying vault, curator role and contract in its documentation. Check asset concentration, curator permissions and available redemption liquidity.

label: Research first
text: Identify a documented public product and its access terms. Check custody, lockup and redemption, and record whether a small, reversible trial is possible.

label: Collateral research
text: Read the collateral requirements, liquidation threshold, costs and repayment route. Use a preview to understand the position without opening debt.

label: Supply-only trial
text: Find a verified public market that accepts an asset you already hold. Review deposit cap, utilization and redemption liquidity before previewing a supply-only position. Keep borrowing disabled.

label: Single swap trial
text: Preview one swap for an asset you need on a documented liquid pair. Record the fee, price impact and minimum output. Skip the trial if price impact exceeds 0.5%.

label: Vault trial
text: Find a documented vault with a deposit minimum below the limit. Verify the underlying asset, share price, current capacity and lockup before previewing a deposit.
